svg.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: Where the real-time control lives
svg.desc: Four panels. (a) QICK: one processor feeds timed queues for every channel, and the readout feeds back into it. (b) QubiC, QiController and RISC-Q as built for QEC: one core per qubit, with a result hub returning measurements to the cores. (c) FIREQ: a trigger table with no processor and no reported conditional path. (d) SQ-CARS: a fixed state machine; readout data goes by DMA to the ARM, and feedback is claimed but not demonstrated.
svg.text: the readout feeds the processor, which branches
QubiC, QiController, RISC-Q as built for QEC
a hub hands each core the results it waits on
